appraisal_events.evidence: cette actrice si convoitée n'était-ce pas elle qui, retirée par moi de la scène, enfermée chez moi, était à l'abri des désirs de tous... Elle était si bien encagée
appraisal_events.explanation: Albertine, once the widely desired, freely roaming figure of the Balbec beach whom everyone pursued, is narrated as now withdrawn from that admiring world and confined in the narrator's home, obedient to him alone and out of reach of every other suitor.

appraisal_events.evidence: chez M. de Charlus une insoupçonnable et immense bonté, mêlée de duretés qu'elle ne connaissait pas... elle avait découvert chez Morel... des profondeurs de méchanceté et de perfidie
appraisal_events.explanation: Reported at second hand, the niece of Jupien reverses her earlier fixed judgments: Charlus, formerly seen only as a tyrannical, cruel figure, is now credited with deep unsuspected kindness (though still capable of harshness), while Morel, formerly seen as delicate, is now found to harbor real cruelty and duplicity beneath his charm.

status_effects.explanation: She is described as taken off the public 'stage' of admirers and shut away in the narrator's home, a boundary crossing from courted beach figure to sequestered captive.

He takes evident pride and gains relational leverage in having secluded Albertine from all rivals and secured her exclusive obedience, though the passage's close ('je ne la possédais pas') qualifies this as incomplete possession.
The revised private judgment now credits him with unsuspected deep kindness, locally raising him in esteem even though qualified by acknowledged harshness.
The revised private judgment now attributes to him hidden cruelty and perfidy beneath his earlier apparent delicacy, locally diminishing him despite softening qualifications.

ambiguities: The evaluator behind the Morel/Charlus reversal is 'la nièce de Jupien,' a descriptor-identified figure not on the reference sheet as a reviewed entity; her judgment is reported at second hand by the narrator ('il paraît, je l'ai su depuis'), so the event's source is marked unknown rather than attributed to an invented character entity.
